## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Tulle, France. It starts at Prudhomat.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover an awe-inspiring architectural masterpiece of **Château de Castelnau-Bretenoux** perched atop a rocky plateau.
>
> Surveying the convergence of four rivers – Cère, Bave, Mamoul, and Dordogne – the castle is aptly described by the renowned writer Prosper Mérimée as "a summary of medieval art". Step inside and immerse yourself in a world of timeless beauty and refinement in Quercy.
>
> The exquisite apartments, now accessible to the public, showcase a meticulously curated collection of furniture and artwork, personally handpicked by Jean Mouliérat himself. Every piece tells a story and evokes a sense of grandeur that transports you to another era.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €9.85. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 31 ratings and 18 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
